shows: Opening a sample item, renaming it, and seeing the list show the new name.
script: await page.waitForTimeout(1200); await page.getByRole('link', { name: 'Example 1', exact: true }).click({ timeout: 5000 }); await page.waitForTimeout(1000); await page.getByRole('textbox', { name: 'Title', exact: true }).fill('Example 1, renamed', { timeout: 5000 }); await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Save', exact: true }).click({ timeout: 5000 }); await page.getByRole('link', { name: 'Example 1, renamed', exact: true }).waitFor({ timeout: 5000 }); await page.waitForTimeout(2500);
